t: LAP 1-Gang LED dimmer switch in brushed steel with a flat, screwed faceplate and colour-matched inserts. Featuring leading or trailing edge control, it supports dimmable LED, halogen, incandescent, and CFL lighting. Built for durability with captive terminal screws and 35mm back box compatibility, it ensures stable, flicker-free operation. Current and thermal overload protection guarantees safety and long-term reliability for mains voltage lighting.
b: Leading Edge or Trailing Edge Option
